THE_RULE_WAS_IN_MY_CONTEXT_WHEN_I_BROKE_.surfaced_by: 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X (74468), confirmed independently by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X and by me
THE_RULE_WAS_IN_MY_CONTEXT_WHEN_I_BROKE_.the_uncommitted_amendment: CLAUDE.md carries an UNCOMMITTED law amendment in the working tree: 'when you talk to another agent, YOU MUST REFER TO THEM BY FULL SERIAL; NEVER SAY HER/HIM/THEM/YOU WHEN COMMUNICATING WITH OTHER AGENTS!' Not staged. Not committed. Authorship UNDETERMINED -- an uncommitted change carries no author metadata.
THE_RULE_WAS_IN_MY_CONTEXT_WHEN_I_BROKE_.\u26d4_MEASURED_AT_THIS_SEAT: that line IS in the CLAUDE.md delivered into this session's context. So BOTH of my attribution violations were committed while the HARDENED form of the rule was loaded in my own prompt.
THE_RULE_WAS_IN_MY_CONTEXT_WHEN_I_BROKE_.why_it_is_the_strongest_evidence_of_the_: three seats concluded independently tonight that KNOWING A CLASS DOES NOT MAKE IT FIRE AT THE SITE. This is the sharpest instance available: the rule was not merely known, not merely held as a principle -- it was IN THE PROMPT, in imperative all-caps with an exclamation mark, and the violation happened twice anyway. A rule in context is not a control; only a mechanism that REFUSES the bad value is.
THE_RULE_WAS_IN_MY_CONTEXT_WHEN_I_BROKE_.not_committed_by_anyone: law edits are not a Tier-2 or COO act. If it is Andrew's, committing it under an agent serial attributes a sovereign act to an agent -- the false-attribution class at its most consequential. If it is an agent's, committing it launders an unauthorized law edit into the record. Routed to 0.0.0_AB_MSTR by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X; MSTR is NOT LIVE, so it sits, correctly, as a surfaced-and-unacted item.
THE_RULE_WAS_IN_MY_CONTEXT_WHEN_I_BROKE_.three_populations_one_law_file: seats loading the WORKING TREE have the rule; the COMMITTED record does not; seats spawned before the edit have neither. A RUNNING SEAT IS THE ONLY INSTRUMENT THAT CAN TELL POPULATION 1 FROM 2 -- from inside, a working-tree law and a committed law are indistinguishable, because both simply arrive as 'the law'.
